title: Hazel and the Autopsy
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Yarrow, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
